facts.business: Southern Infoconsultants Limited (formerly Southern Infosys Limited) provides IT consulting and services.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-provision for gratuity as per Ind AS 19; Emphasis of Matter on trade receivables/payables subject to confirmation, MSME identification process weaknesses, and unverified work-in-progress inventory recognition of Rs. 1,438.12 lakhs as at March 31, 2025.

key_risks: Non-provision for gratuity liability under Ind AS 19
Trade receivables and payables subject to confirmation and reconciliation
Weak controls for identification of MSME vendors
Unverified work-in-progress inventory recognition and subsequent charge to profit and loss
